name: CineStream
description: One stop solution for Movies, Series, Anime, AsianDrama and Torrents (includes CineAnime: AniList + TMDB + AnimePahe). v540: Cloudflare WebView actually loads and saves cookies. (1) Cookie detection now uses lenient cf_clearance= check (any length) instead of strict 15+ char regex. (2) WebView now forces challenge page load for API endpoints, not just API URLs. (3) Headless and visible modes both use lenient cf_clearance= detection (any length). (4) Fixed toggle inversion - bypass now respects visible/invisible setting correctly. (5) probeAndResolveIfNeeded actually shows bypass WebView with correct visibility. (6) context stored for currentActivity() so bypass can find Activity. (7) WebView forces challenge page load for API endpoints. (8) 30s fail-fast timeout, kwik.cx in bypass, cleared in-flight on dismiss, background init, Domain=.host clearing.
